api.base_url: https://app.clio.com/api/v4 (US); ca.app.clio.com, au.app.clio.com, eu.app.clio.com for other regions

scopes_needed_read: Per Clio permissions section (docs.developers.clio.com/api-docs/clio-manage/permissions/); scope names UNVERIFIED
auth.token_lifetime: Access token 30 days (2592000 expires_in); 401 on expiry
auth.refresh: 'refresh tokens do not expire'; POST /oauth/token with grant_type=refresh_token. Tokens issued against app.clio.com 'are not valid against EU, CA, or AU endpoints', so store the user's region.

access_requirements.partner_program_name: Clio Developer account (apps); Clio App Directory for listings
access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: Register an application in a Clio developer account to get key and secret. App Directory listing is optional and reviewed (terms UNVERIFIED).
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: A user at the firm authorizes our app via the OAuth consent screen (in their region); firm admin approval may be required by firm policy (UNVERIFIED).
access_requirements.cost_to_us: $0 for developer account (UNVERIFIED on a fetched pricing page)

sandbox.how_to_get: Developer account docs reference a developer sandbox account; steps UNVERIFIED.

rate_limits: Documented at /api-docs/clio-manage/rate-limits/; page not read, numbers UNVERIFIED.
incremental_sync: UNVERIFIED (Clio v4 list endpoints commonly accept updated_since; confirm in reference).
blockers: Region-aware token handling required (four regional hosts)
sources: https://docs.developers.clio.com/api-docs/clio-manage/authorization/ - 'Access tokens expire after 30 days'; 'refresh tokens do not expire'; regional host note; create an application in your Clio developer account
